purpose: Reference registry for Albion Online screenshot item identification. Separate from TearOfMoon economic data.

metadata.provider: Albion Online Data Project / ao-data ao-bin-dumps

icons.enchantmentSyntax: Append @1, @2 or @3 to the item identifier when applicable

workflow: use tier, enchantment, quality and slot context to narrow candidates
resolve candidates against UniqueName and localized names
compare the screenshot icon with the corresponding Albion Render Service icon
report ambiguous matches instead of guessing

confidence.high: icon and metadata agree; return exact item
confidence.medium: small set of plausible matches; report candidates
confidence.low: do not assign an item ID without user confirmation

notes: Do not duplicate the full Albion icon library in Merchant Empire; resolve icons from item IDs on demand.
The visual registry is reference data and must not change Silver, ledger, orders or warehouse quantities.
Prefer the current ao-data fork rather than the archived upstream broderickhyman repository.
